trails.note: Green slow-zone (dot-grid) band; its circle (1353,1718) sits on the band's bend. Traced from where the band leaves the Perry Merrill Ave / Chalet Meadows junction (~1289,1440), down the west edge of the Moon woods to the bend, then SE past the junction where Quarter Moon, Half Moon and a dotted connector band from the Interstate zone meet (~1550,1850), to where it merges into the Tramside base slow zone by the moving carpet (~1710,1985). The white diagonal cut just NE of the band, under the label text, is not dotted and continues Quarter Moon from its label, so it is not this trail.

Blue: faint open cut leaving Perry Merrill Ave (~1392,1430), running down past the square (1403,1512) to ~1420,1605, then a clear white cut curving SE (it passes under the Queen's Highway label text) to the V where it meets Half Moon just above the Queen's Highway band (~1552,1822). Upper half is faint in the painting (checked on a brightness-smoothed image); lower half is clear.

Blue: open cut from Perry Merrill Ave (~1550,1428) down through the woods, passing just east of the square (1517,1656), then down to meet Quarter Moon at the V above the Queen's Highway band (~1556,1820). Visible on zoomed crops and the brightness-smoothed image.

Blue: clear white cut from the Perry Merrill Ave band (~1722,1343) down past the square (1685,1482), bending SW to ~1650,1580, then S along the west side of a conifer island to the dotted connector band (~1675,1722) that links the Interstate zone to the Queen's Highway junction. An unlabeled cut above Perry Merrill Ave (from the Lower River Quai corridor, ~1880,1180 to 1745,1320) lines up with its top; not included (could be its upper part or Lower River Quai's runout). The dotted connector band below is not included either.

Green: the central dotted slow zone is split into lanes by the Aerial Tram, Metro Quad and Flyer lines and tree strips; the Interstate circle (1746,1570) is in the lane west of the Aerial Tram. Traced from the top of the slow zone (~1850,1300) down that lane (narrow between a conifer island and the Tram line to y~1500, then wide) to the base between the moving carpet and the Aerial Tram base (~1745,2060). Lane boundaries inside the slow zone are inferred from the circle.

Green: circle (1917,1479) sits in the narrow dotted lane between a thin tree strip and the Metro Quad line (the text lies east of the lift, on a tree island). Traced along that lane on the west side of the Metro Quad from its top terminal (~1935,1300) to near its base (~1846,2060). The parallel dotted lane west of the tree strip (between it and the Aerial Tram) may also be Subway; boundaries inside the slow zone are inferred.

Green: circle (1964,1772) is in the dotted lane between the Metro Quad and Flyer Express Quad lines (the text runs over forest east of the Flyer, which has no cut). Traced that lane from the top of the slow zone (~2012,1325, between Subway's tree island and the Flyer) down to near the Flyer base (~1900,2060). Top section assumed from continuity of the lane.

Black: the label fills a narrow open corridor between a conifer band (above) and a mixed tree band (below). It forks off the Lower Goat Run corridor at ~1700,1093 and runs WSW to the Lower Can Am / Taxi slow zone at ~1465,1162. The wider cut that drops S then SW below the mixed tree band is unlabeled (likely Lower Goat Run continuing) and is not included.
